title: Finite-machine padding construction
statement: Given a finite Turing machine $D$ over the Boolean alphabet and a natural number $r$, define a multi-tape Turing machine with $D$’s initial state and state set, and with $D.k+r$ work tapes. Its transition in state $q$, on input symbol $a$ and work-tape symbols $w$, is obtained by applying the left-action transformation with parameter $r$ and the identity map to the action of $D$ in state $q$ on $a$ and the first $D.k$ work-tape symbols.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $D$ over the Boolean alphabet
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the left-action transformation, so its effect on the action cannot be described more explicitly.
